look_here_first: Look for the nodding leathery urn: dull blue-purple to reddish-purple sepals stay connivent for most of their length, then develop narrow expanded, often crisped/recurved tips.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: four thick leathery bluish to reddish-purple sepals

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: distal sepal margins narrowly expanded and often crispate/recurved

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: achene beaks short, about 1–3 cm, nearly glabrous to appressed-pubescent

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Perennial woody-based climber, commonly dying back above ground.

key_traits.label: Leaf morphology
key_traits.text: Simple to 1–2-pinnate; leaflets variable and often coarsely reticulate.

key_traits.label: Flower
key_traits.text: Nodding leathery purple urn with narrow expanded/crisped distal sepal margins.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Achenes with relatively short 1–3 cm beaks, not strongly plumose.
